REGISTRATION.TITLE: Business / Company Registration
REGISTRATION.SUBTITLE: Register your Business to access WMA online services for business operators.
REGISTRATION.INSTRUCTIONS: Please follow the steps below to register your Business/Company on the WMA Online Services platform.
REGISTRATION.STEP1_DESC: Select business/company category, provide identity, address, and office phone number.
REGISTRATION.STEP2_DESC: Private companies must provide owner details and correspondence address.
REGISTRATION.STEP3_DESC: Provide the primary contact person responsible for communication with WMA.
REGISTRATION.STEP4_DESC: Create login credentials to complete account registration.
REGISTRATION.PREPARE_ITEM5: Contact person email and phone number
